item.title: Claude Code Plugins: Install, Scope and Remove (2026)
item.description:
What is a Claude Code plugin?

A Claude Code plugin is a folder that bundles skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers, so you can install them as one unit. Most plugins come from a marketplace, a catalog that lists plugins and where to get each one. The folder has a manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json that gives it a name and version.

Use a plugin when you want several of these pieces packaged together, with updates from the marketplace. A single skill or MCP server you can also set up on its own. For those, see Claude Code MCP and Claude Code skills.

item.title: Hermes Agent Plugins: Install, Catalog, Memory Providers
item.description:
Hermes Agent plugins are folders of Python code with a plugin.yaml manifest that add tools, hooks, slash commands, memory backends and other features without changing Hermes’s core. You install them with hermes plugins install <name> from a human-reviewed, commit-pinned catalog, or from any Git repo. Memory provider plugins are a special kind: only one runs at a time.

Hermes Agent is Nous Research’s open-source (MIT) agent, with about 256,000 GitHub stars on October 21, 2026. This page covers the plugin system: plugin types, install commands, the catalog, how memory providers hook in, and which ones exist. For how Hermes’s built-in memory works (MEMORY.md, USER.md, session search), see Hermes Agent memory. Facts come from the Hermes plugin docs and the repo’s plugin-catalog/ folder, checked October 21, 2026.
